Nadia: Quick check 1: can we triage a minimal GA launch gate checklist by noon? Need one-liners for SLA copy, support runbook, oncall thresholds, monitoring alerts, and pricing smoke.

Owen: I'll own monitoring/oncall. Short items: p95 latency target <= 350ms, alert if 5xx > 5% over 5m, include runbook URL in alert.

Helena: Docs+support here. I'll assemble a 1-page handoff with curl examples, rollback step, and a short FAQ. Please paste exact error strings.

Nadia: I'll handle SLA paragraph (keeps it generic uptime + force majeure exceptions) and coordinate legal if needed.

InfraBot: Ticket GL-900 created, assigned Nadia/Owen/Helena, due today.

Owen: Running 10m smoke at 11:30 UTC. Plan: 10 qps, small payloads, verify p95 and alert triggers.

(11:45) Owen: Smoke finished. p95=320ms, one 60s spike at 11:33 that triggered fallback; alert fired and included runbook link. Logged timeline in GL-900.

Helena: Updated runbook with TL;DR, curl sample, rollback steps, and copied two error strings Owen pasted: "model_kv_overflow" and "rate_limit_exceeded". Link: internal://docs/ga/handoff.md (placeholder).

Nadia: SLA blurb pushed. Final ask: everyone react with :white_check_mark: when done; I'll compile handoff to sales/support.
